nodes.text:
Dendritic cells exposed to HMPV particles promote naïve CD4 T-cells' differentiation into Th2 cells, which are linked to allergies and asthma. This shift weakens the antiviral response necessary to fight HMPV, highlighting its impact on immune system behavior.
